punchline: Intel did not sell the faster chip; it sold the chip, the tools and the support behind it.
thirty_sec: In 1980 Intel set a goal of 2,000 design wins for the 8086 and mobilized the whole company, selling a complete solution of chip, tools and support. Participants recall about 2,300 wins, and the approach helped land the IBM PC socket.
question: Where are you competing on a spec sheet when the customer is really asking who will help when it breaks?
key_contrast: A feature race versus a complete solution with a countable goal.
